sources.title: Orwa et al. (2009), Agroforestree Database 4.0: Terminalia catappa
sources.retrievalNote: The food paragraph describes raw or roasted kernels. Adjacent medicinal claims were not adopted.
sources.limitation: Food use does not validate leaf or bark treatment, a therapeutic dose or general clinical safety. No cooking time or temperature is supplied.

sources.title: Biego et al. (2012), Physicochemical Quality of Kernels from Terminalia catappa L. and Sensory Evaluation of the Concocted Kernels
sources.retrievalNote: The kernel extraction and appetizer-processing sections were inspected directly in the downloaded six-page paper, not inferred from a search snippet.
sources.limitation: A food-processing and sensory study, not a human treatment trial. Roasting time, temperature, medicinal dosage and household storage safety are not established.

proposal.preparationPart: Fruit kernels, not leaf or bark
proposal.proposedPreparationMethod: Food preparation only, not treatment: a published study sun-dried ripe fruits for one week, extracted kernels with a nutcracker, then roasted whole kernels with or without salt. It supplies no roasting temperature or duration. This describes kernel-food processing, not a validated medicinal preparation or treatment dose.
historicalExclusions: Keep bark treatment recipes and historical doses withheld.
Do not transfer kernel-food processing to leaf teas, root extracts, medicinal oil or other Terminalia species.

limitations: The earlier preparation supplement is preserved as its historical checkpoint. Only its Talisay food-description proposal is superseded here.
No new identity or duplicate herb is proposed. The first-ten draft planner was not regenerated and no live Library field or AI retrieval result changed.
Only the identified relevant source sections were reviewed; no full-paper clinical appraisal or preparation coverage for the remaining thirty candidates is claimed.
